```{r functions}
SRCPATH <- Sys.getenv("SRCPATH")
PROJECTPATH <- Sys.getenv("PROJECTPATH")

source(file.path(SRCPATH, "enrichment.R"))


#' Compute empirical p-values
#'
#' @param x An array-like object of rank p (e.g. vector or matrix)
#' @param samples An array-like object of rank p+1, with the added dimension
#' containing null samples of x
#' @param normalize Option to normalize tail sums for p-values
#'
#' @returns An array-like object of the same size as x containing p-values
compute_empirical_pvalues <- function(x, samples, normalize = TRUE) {
  
  if (is.null(dim(samples))) {
    n_dims <- 1
    n_samples <- length(samples)
    x_rep <- rep(x, n_samples)
    pvals <- sum(samples >= x_rep)
  } else {
    n_dims <- length(dim(samples))
    n_samples <- dim(samples)[n_dims]
    x_rep <- array(rep(as.vector(x), times = n_samples),
                   dim = dim(samples))
    pvals <- rowSums(samples >= x_rep, dims = n_dims-1)
  }
  
  if (normalize) {
    pvals <- (pvals + 1)/(n_samples + 1)
  }
  
  return(pvals)
}


#' Compute empirical p-values from sample batch files
#'
#' @param x 
#' @param batch_files 
#'
#' @returns
compute_batched_pvalues_v1 <- function(x, batch_files) {
  
  B <- 0
  tail_sum <- matrix(data = 0, nrow = nrow(x), ncol = ncol(x))
  for (i in 1:length(batch_files)) {
    
    message(paste("On batch", i, "of", length(batch_files), "..."))
    
    # Import permutations enrichment values
    samples_batch <- simplify2array(
      map(.x = readRDS(file = batch_files[i]), .f = function(x){x$result$enrichment})
    )
    gc()
    
    B_batch <- dim(samples_batch)[length(dim(samples_batch))]
    
    # Compute tail sum for batch
    tail_sum_batch <- compute_empirical_pvalues(x = x, samples = samples_batch, 
                                                normalize = FALSE)
    
    # Update tail sum and number of samples
    tail_sum <- tail_sum + tail_sum_batch
    B <- B + B_batch
    
  }

  # Compute p-values  
  pvals <- (tail_sum + 1)/(B + 1)
  rownames(pvals) <- rownames(x)
  colnames(pvals) <- colnames(x)
  
  gc()
  
  return(pvals)

}


#' Compute empirical p-values from batches of samples
#'
#' @param x An array-like object of rank p
#' @param batch_files (character vector) Files (RDS) containing permutation samples
#' of the same size as x
#' @param transform (function) Optional function to transform x and batch samples
#' @param ... Optional arguments to transform function
#'
#' @returns An array of p-values of the same size as x
compute_batched_pvalues <- function(x, batch_files, transform = identity, ...) {
  
  x <- transform(x, ...)
  
  B <- 0
  if (is.null(dim(x))) {
    tail_sum <- numeric(length(x))
  } else {
    tail_sum <- matrix(data = 0, nrow = nrow(x), ncol = ncol(x))
  }
  for (i in 1:length(batch_files)) {
    
    message(paste("On batch", i, "of", length(batch_files), "..."))
    
    # Import permutations enrichment values
    samples_batch <- simplify2array(
      map(.x = readRDS(file = batch_files[i]), 
          .f = function(x){x$result$enrichment})
    )
    gc()
    
    B_batch <- dim(samples_batch)[length(dim(samples_batch))]
    
    samples_batch <- apply(X = samples_batch, MARGIN = 3, FUN = transform, ...)
    
    # Compute tail sum for batch
    tail_sum_batch <- compute_empirical_pvalues(x = x, samples = samples_batch, 
                                                normalize = FALSE)
    
    # Update tail sum and number of samples
    tail_sum <- tail_sum + tail_sum_batch
    B <- B + B_batch
    
  }
  
  # Compute p-values  
  pvals <- (tail_sum + 1)/(B + 1)
  rownames(pvals) <- rownames(x)
  colnames(pvals) <- colnames(x)
  
  gc()
  
  return(pvals)
  
}
```

# Import

```{r import-reactome-hierarchy}
# Path to Reactome hierarchy file
reactome_hierarchy <- file.path(PROJECTPATH,  "data/enrichment/reactome_hierarchy.csv")

# Import Reactome hierarchy
df_reactome_hierarchy <- read_csv(reactome_hierarchy, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Initialize tree levels for root pathways
df_reactome_hierarchy <- df_reactome_hierarchy %>% 
  mutate(level = ifelse(is.na(ParentID), 0, NA))

# Iterate lvl down the tree
nmissing <- sum(is.na(df_reactome_hierarchy$level))
lvl <- 0
while (nmissing > 0) {
  
  df_reactome_lvl <- df_reactome_hierarchy %>% 
    filter(level == lvl)
  
  # Iterate over nodes at given level
  for (i in 1:nrow(df_reactome_lvl)){
    
    node <- df_reactome_lvl[[i, "Name"]]
    
    df_reactome_hierarchy <- df_reactome_hierarchy %>% 
      mutate(level = ifelse(is.na(Parent), 0, 
                            ifelse(Parent == node, lvl+1, level)))
    
  }
  
  nmissing <- sum(is.na(df_reactome_hierarchy$level))
  lvl <- lvl + 1
  
}

# Clean up names
df_reactome_hierarchy <- df_reactome_hierarchy %>% 
  mutate(Name = str_replace_all(Name, "  ", " "),
         Name = str_replace_all(Name, "/", " "))
```

```{r import-reactome-modules}
# Bader Reactome gene sets
module_file <- file.path(PROJECTPATH,  "data/enrichment/Human_Reactome_June_01_2025_symbol.gmt")

# Import Bader sets
df_modules <- get_module_sizes(modules = module_file)

# Clean up IDs
df_modules <- df_modules %>% 
  rename(IDBader = ID) %>% 
  mutate(ID = IDBader %>% 
           str_split_i("%", i = -1) %>% 
           str_remove("R-HSA-") %>% 
           str_remove("\\.[0-9]+"),
         ID = paste0("R-HSA-", ID)) %>% 
  mutate(Title = str_replace_all(Title, "  ", " "))

# Include hierarchy information
df_reactome <- inner_join(df_reactome_hierarchy,
                          df_modules,
                          by = "ID")

# Some pathways have multiple parents. Clean those
ids_multiple <- df_reactome |> 
  group_by(ID) |> 
  count() |> 
  filter(n > 1) |> 
  pull(ID)

df_reactome_unique <- df_reactome |> 
  filter(!(ID %in% ids_multiple))

df_reactome_multiple <- df_reactome |> 
  filter(ID %in% ids_multiple)

df_reactome_multiple <- df_reactome_multiple |> 
  filter(!(Root %in% c("Cell Cycle", "Signal Transduction",
                       "Metabolism of proteins", "Sensory Perception")))

df_reactome <- bind_rows(df_reactome_unique, df_reactome_multiple)

# Pathways to keep
pathway_ids_keep <- df_reactome %>% 
  filter(Root != "Disease") |> 
  filter(B > 10) %>% 
  pull(IDBader)
```

```{r import-enrichment}
enrichment_dir <- file.path(PROJECTPATH, "data/mouse/derivatives/v3/107/enrichment/StringDB_12.0_Bader_2025/950")

# Import enrichment data
enrichment_file <- "cluster_pathway_enrichment.csv"
enrichment_file <- file.path(enrichment_dir, enrichment_file)
df_enrichment <- read_csv(enrichment_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Get cluster ID levels
cluster_lvls <- df_enrichment |> 
  select(nk, k, cluster_id) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  arrange(nk, k) |>
  pull(cluster_id)

# Convert cluster IDs to factor
df_enrichment <- df_enrichment |> 
  mutate(cluster_id = factor(cluster_id, levels = cluster_lvls))

# Build matrix of enrichment values
mat_E_all <- df_enrichment |> 
  select(ID, cluster_id, E) |> 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "ID", names_from = "cluster_id", values_from = "E") |> 
  arrange(ID) |> 
  column_to_rownames("ID") |> 
  as.matrix()

# Build matrix of enrichment values
mat_p_hypergeom_all <- df_enrichment |> 
  select(ID, cluster_id, P.Value) |> 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "ID", names_from = "cluster_id", values_from = "P.Value") |> 
  arrange(ID) |> 
  column_to_rownames("ID") |> 
  as.matrix()

# Filter for pathway subset
idx_pathways <- rownames(mat_E_all) %in% pathway_ids_keep
mat_E <- mat_E_all[idx_pathways,]
mat_p_hypergeom <- mat_p_hypergeom_all[idx_pathways,]
```

```{r compute-enrichment-pvals}
# Get permutation files
permutations_dir <- file.path(enrichment_dir, "permutations")
df_permutation_files <- tibble(file = list.files(permutations_dir)) |> 
  mutate(seed_start = file |> 
           str_remove("cluster_pathway_enrichment_permutations_") |> 
           str_remove("_[0-9]+.rds") |> 
           as.integer(),
         seed_end = file |> 
           str_remove("cluster_pathway_enrichment_permutations_[0-9]+_") |> 
           str_remove(".rds") |> 
           as.integer()) |> 
  mutate(file = file.path(permutations_dir, file)) |> 
  mutate(B = seed_end - seed_start + 1) |> 
  arrange(seed_start)

# Get the number of permutations
B <- df_permutation_files |> pull(B) |> sum()

# Compute empirical p-values based on permutation samples
mat_p_permutations_all <- compute_batched_pvalues(x = mat_E_all, 
                                                  batch_files = df_permutation_files$file)

# Filter for pathway subset
idx_pathways <- rownames(mat_p_permutations_all) %in% pathway_ids_keep
mat_p_permutations <- mat_p_permutations_all[idx_pathways,]
```

# Comparison between hypergeometric and permutation significance

## Comparison of p-values

```{r}
# Smallest possible p-value
pvals_permute_min <- 1/(B + 1)

df_permutation_pvals <- mat_p_permutations |> 
  as_tibble(rownames = "ID") |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = -ID, names_to = "cluster_id", values_to = "p.value") 

# Correct permutation p-values for MC
mat_q_permutations <- apply(mat_p_permutations, MARGIN = 2, FUN = p.adjust, method = "BH")

# Convert permutations q-value data to long data frame
df_permutation_qvals <- mat_q_permutations |> 
  as_tibble(rownames = "ID") |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = -ID, names_to = "cluster_id", values_to = "q.value") 

df_permutation_stats <- inner_join(df_permutation_pvals, 
                                   df_permutation_qvals, 
                                   by = c("ID", "cluster_id"))
```

```{r}
# Convert hypergeometric q-value data to long data frame
df_hypergeometric_pvals <- mat_p_hypergeom |>
  as_tibble(rownames = "ID") |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = -ID, names_to = "cluster_id", values_to = "p.value")  

df_hypergeometric_qvals_full <- df_enrichment |>
  filter(ID %in% pathway_ids_keep) |> 
  select(ID, cluster_id, q.value.full = adj.P.Val)

df_hypergeometric_qvals <- df_enrichment |>
  filter(ID %in% pathway_ids_keep) |> 
  mutate(P.Value = ifelse(P.Value < pvals_permute_min, pvals_permute_min, P.Value)) |>
  group_by(cluster_id) |>
  mutate(q.value = p.adjust(P.Value, method = "fdr")) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(ID, cluster_id, q.value)

df_hypergeometric_stats <- df_hypergeometric_pvals |> 
  inner_join(df_hypergeometric_qvals_full, by = c("ID", "cluster_id")) |> 
  inner_join(df_hypergeometric_qvals, by = c("ID", "cluster_id"))

```

```{r}
df_compare_nulls <- inner_join(
  df_permutation_stats |> 
    rename(p.value.permute = p.value,
           q.value.permute = q.value),
  df_hypergeometric_stats |> 
    rename(p.value.hypergeom = p.value,
           q.value.hypergeom = q.value,
           q.value.hypergeom.full = q.value.full),
  by = c("ID", "cluster_id")
)

df_compare_nulls <- df_compare_nulls |> 
  filter(!is.na(p.value.permute))

df_compare_nulls <- df_compare_nulls |> 
  left_join(df_enrichment |> 
              select(ID, cluster_id, E),
            by = c("ID", "cluster_id")) 
```

```{r}
df_plot_pvals <- df_compare_nulls |> 
  select(ID, cluster_id, p.value.permute, p.value.hypergeom) |> 
  mutate(p.value.hypergeom.clamped = ifelse(p.value.hypergeom < pvals_permute_min,
                                            pvals_permute_min, 
                                            p.value.hypergeom))

axis_breaks <- c(0, -log10(c(0.05, 0.01, 0.001, 0.0001, 0.00001)))
axis_breaks <- round(axis_breaks, 2)

# Plot p-value comparison at full range
plt_null_pvals_full <- ggplot(df_plot_pvals, 
                              aes(x = -log10(p.value.hypergeom), 
                                  y = -log10(p.value.permute))) + 
  geom_point(size = 0.2) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = -log10(0.05), col = "red") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), col = "red") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 10)) + 
  labs(x = "Hypergeometric Test p-value (-log10)",
       y = "Permutation p-value (-log10)",
       title = "Parametric p-values full range") + 
  theme_bw()

plt_null_pvals_clamped <- ggplot(df_plot_pvals,
                                 aes(x = -log10(p.value.hypergeom.clamped),
                                     y = -log10(p.value.permute))) + 
  geom_point(size = 0.2) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = -log10(0.05), col = "red") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), col = "red") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = axis_breaks) + 
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = axis_breaks) + 
  labs(x = "Hypergeometric Test p-value (-log10)",
       y = "Permutation p-value (-log10)",
       title = "Parametric p-values clamped") + 
  theme_bw()

# Patchwork for p-value comparison
plt_null_pvals <- (plt_null_pvals_clamped + plt_null_pvals_full) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(0.40, 0.60)) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Null hypothesis comparison for all cluster pathways",
                  tag_levels = "A")

outfile <- "enrichment_null_comparison_pvals.pdf"
pdf(file = outfile,
    width = unit(10, "in"),
    height = unit(6, "in"))
print(plt_null_pvals)
invisible(dev.off())
```

```{r}
print(plt_null_qvals)
invisible(dev.off())
```

What are we finding so far? - There are four categories of results: 1. Not significant ever 2. Significant in the parametric test only 3. Significant in the permutation test only 4. Significant in both the permutation and parametric tests

This is for all pathways across all clusters

```{r comparison-qvals-bins}
# q-value threshold for significance
q_threshold <- 0.05

df_compare_nulls <- df_compare_nulls |> 
  separate(col = "cluster_id", into = c("nk", "k"), sep = "-", remove = FALSE) |> 
  mutate(nk = as.integer(nk), k = as.integer(k))

# Significance bins
bins <- c("Neither", "Hypergeometric", "Permutation", "Both")

# Sort pathway-cluster pairs into significance bins
df_compare_nulls <- df_compare_nulls |> 
  mutate(sig_bin = case_when(
    q.value.hypergeom >= q_threshold & q.value.permute >= q_threshold ~ "Neither",
    q.value.hypergeom < q_threshold & q.value.permute >= q_threshold ~ "Hypergeometric",
    q.value.hypergeom >= q_threshold & q.value.permute < q_threshold ~ "Permutation",
    q.value.hypergeom < q_threshold & q.value.permute < q_threshold ~ "Both"
  )) |> 
  mutate(sig_bin = factor(sig_bin, levels = bins))

# Join with Reactome information
df_compare_nulls <- df_compare_nulls |> 
  left_join(df_reactome |> 
              select(ID = IDBader, Name, Parent, Root, level, B),
  by = "ID") 

# Join with mouse cluster labels
df_compare_nulls <- df_compare_nulls |> 
  left_join(df_mouse_cluster_labels, by = "cluster_id")
```

# Are pathways more focused?

```{r}
#' Compute the difference between maximum and median
#'
#' @param x (numeric vector) Vector of values
#' @param na.rm (logical scalar) 
#'
#' @returns (numeric scalar) 
max_med_diff <- function(x, na.rm = FALSE) {
  
  x_max <- max(x, na.rm = na.rm)
  x_med <- median(x, na.rm = na.rm)
  return(x_max - x_med)
}


compute_max_med_diff <- function(x, nk, clusters_drop = NULL) {
  
  if (!is.null(clusters_drop)) {
  idx_drop <- colnames(x) %in% clusters_drop
  } else {
    idx_drop <- logical(ncol(x))
  }
  idx_nk <- str_detect(colnames(x), paste0(nk, "-"))
  idx_clusters <- which(idx_nk & !idx_drop)
  x_nk <- x[,idx_clusters]
 
  max_med <- suppressWarnings(
    apply(x_nk, MARGIN = 1, FUN = max_med_diff, na.rm = TRUE) 
  )

  return(max_med)  
}


compute_max_med_pvalues <- function(x, batch_files, nk_range, clusters_drop = NULL, workers = NULL) {
  
  # If no workers provided, match nk_range
  if (is.null(workers)) {
    workers <- length(nk_range)
  }
  
  # Initialize cluster
  cl <- parallel::makeCluster(workers)
  on.exit({
    parallel::stopCluster(cl)
    foreach::registerDoSEQ()
  }, add = TRUE)
  
  doParallel::registerDoParallel(cl)
  
  # Compute batched p-values
  results <- foreach(
    nk = nk_range,
    .packages = c("tidyverse"),
    .export = c("compute_batched_pvalues",
                "compute_max_med_diff", 
                "max_med_diff", 
                "compute_empirical_pvalues")
  ) %dopar% {
    compute_batched_pvalues(x = x, 
                             batch_files = batch_files,
                             transform = compute_max_med_diff,
                             nk = nk,
                            clusters_drop = clusters_drop)
  }
  
  results <- simplify2array(results)
  colnames(results) <- paste0("nk", nk_range)
  
  return(results)
  
}
```

```{r}
# Compute max-med statistic for nk = 4 to 10
nk_range <- 4:10
mat_max_med <- matrix(data = 0, nrow = nrow(mat_E_all), ncol = length(nk_range))
for (j in 1:ncol(mat_max_med)) {
  mat_max_med[,j] <- compute_max_med_diff(x = mat_E_all, nk = nk_range[j])
}

rownames(mat_max_med) <- rownames(mat_E_all)
colnames(mat_max_med) <- paste0("nk", nk_range)

# Filter for pathway subset
idx_pathways <- rownames(mat_max_med) %in% pathway_ids_keep
mat_max_med <- mat_max_med[idx_pathways,]

# Filter for complete cases
idx_complete <- complete.cases(mat_max_med)
mat_max_med <- mat_max_med[idx_complete,]

# Create stats data frame
df_max_med_stats <- mat_max_med |> 
  as_tibble(rownames = "ID") |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = -ID, names_to = "nk_name", values_to = "max_med_stat") |> 
  mutate(nk = as.numeric(str_remove(nk_name, "nk"))) |> 
  select(-nk_name)
```

```{r}
df_max_med_compare <- inner_join(

           q.value.eq = q.value),
  by = c("ID", "nk")
)

  mutate(p_significant = p.value.native < 0.05 | p.value.eq < 0.05,
         q_significant = q.value.native < 0.05 | q.value.eq < 0.05) 

df_max_med_compare <- df_max_med_compare |> 
  mutate(nk_label = paste0("nk = ", nk),
         nk_label = factor(nk_label, levels = paste0("nk = ", nk_subset)))
```

```{r}
nk_subset <- seq(2, 10, 2)

pt_size <- 0.5
axis_max <- 3.0
axis_expand <- 0.3

set.seed(123)

plt_max_med_pvals_compare <- df_max_med_compare |> 
  filter(nk %in% nk_subset) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = -log10(p.value.native), 
             y = -log10(p.value.eq),
             col = colour)) + 
             # col = p_significant)) +
    annotate(geom = "rect", 
           x = 0, y = 0,
           xmax = -log10(0.05), ymax = -log10(0.05),
           fill = "grey70",
           alpha = 0.5) + 
  geom_point(size = pt_size,
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.05, height = 0.05)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -log10(0.05), col = "red") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), col = "red") + 
  geom_abline(slope = 1, col = "blue", alpha = 0.25) + 
  facet_wrap(~nk_label, ncol = 5) + 
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(add = axis_expand)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(add = axis_expand)) + 
  scale_colour_manual(values = cluster_group_colours, guide = "none") +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(0, axis_max), ylim = c(0, axis_max)) + 
  labs(x = "p-value with native cluster sizes (-log10)",
       y = "p-value with equal cluster sizes (-log10)",
       title = "Nominal p-values") +
  theme_bw()

plt_max_med_qvals_compare <- df_max_med_compare |> 
  filter(nk %in% nk_subset) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = -log10(q.value.native),
             y = -log10(q.value.eq),
             col = colour)) + 
             # col = q_significant)) +
      annotate(geom = "rect", 
           x = 0, y = 0,
           xmax = -log10(0.05), ymax = -log10(0.05),
           fill = "grey70",
           alpha = 0.5) + 
  geom_point(size = pt_size,
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.05, height = 0.05)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -log10(0.05), col = "red") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), col = "red") + 
  geom_abline(slope = 1, col = "blue", alpha = 0.25) + 
  facet_wrap(~nk_label, ncol = 5) + 
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(add = axis_expand)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(add = axis_expand)) + 
  scale_colour_manual(values = cluster_group_colours, guide = "none") +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(0, axis_max), ylim = c(0, axis_max)) + 
  labs(x = "q-value with native cluster sizes (-log10)",
       y = "q-value with equal cluster sizes (-log10)",
       title = "FDR-corrected p-values") +
  theme_bw()

plt <- (plt_max_med_pvals_compare / plt_max_med_qvals_compare) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Comparison of max-med resampled p-values using native vs. equal cluster sizes")

outfile <- "max_med_pval_comparison_native_vs_equal_clusters.pdf"
pdf(file = outfile,
    width = unit(12, "in"),
    height = unit(7, "in"))
print(plt)
invisible(dev.off())
```

# Anatomical segregation of pathways

## UMAP analysis

```{r}
# Get complete cases
idx_complete <- complete.cases(mat_E)

# Run UMAP
set.seed(123)
umap_out <- uwot::umap2(X = t(mat_E[idx_complete,]), ret_model = TRUE)
colnames(umap_out$embedding) <- paste0("U", 1:2)

# Convert to data frame and add grouping information
df_umap <- as_tibble(umap_out$embedding, rownames = "cluster_id") |> 
  left_join(df_mouse_cluster_labels, by = "cluster_id")

group_colours <- df_umap |> 
  pull(colour) |> 
  unique() |> 
  sort()

ggplot(df_umap, aes(x = U1, y = U2, fill = colour)) + 
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 3, col = "grey50") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colours) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-4, 6), ylim = c(-5, 4)) + 
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
cluster_enrichment_dist <- dist(x = umap_out$embedding)

df_cluster_enrichment_dist <- tibble(x = as.numeric(dist_euclidean))

ggplot(df_cluster_enrichment_dist, aes(x = x, after_stat(density))) + 
  geom_histogram()
```

```{r}
df_pathway_qvals <- inner_join(
  mat_enrichment_qvals[idx_pathway,] |> 
    enframe(name = "cluster_id", value = "pvals_hypergeom"),
  permutation_qvals[idx_pathway,] |> 
    enframe(name = "cluster_id", value = "qvals_permute"), 
  by = "cluster_id"
)

df_pathway_qvals <- df_pathway_qvals |> 
  left_join(df_mouse_cluster_labels, by = "cluster_id") |> 
  select(-cluster_id, cluster_id = cluster_id_new)

df_pathway_qvals <- df_pathway_qvals |> 
  separate(col = "cluster_id", into = c("nk", "k"), remove = FALSE) |> 
  mutate(nk = factor(as.numeric(nk)))

plt_null_wnt <- ggplot(df_pathway_qvals, 
                       aes(x = -log10(pvals_hypergeom), 
                           y = -log10(qvals_permute),
                           label = cluster_id,
                           col = nk)) + 
  geom_text() +
  # geom_point(size = 2) + 
  # geom_abline(slope = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -log10(0.05), col = "red") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), col = "red") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 5)) + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, -log10(1/1001))) + 
  labs(x = "Hypergeometric Test q-value (-log10)",
       y = "Permutation q-value (-log10)",
       title = paste0("Null hypothesis comparison: ", pathway)) + 
  theme_bw()

outfile <- "enrichment_null_comparison_PPI_qvals.pdf"
pdf(file = outfile,
    width = unit(6, "in"),
    height = unit(6, "in"))
print(plt_null_wnt)
invisible(dev.off())

```
